And maybe one of the several different prison gangs that want his scalp for overdue loan payments. That’s about right, isn’t it, Tugnut?|[[Waste]] and [[Zahara Cody]]|<ref name="Death" />}}
'''Tugnut''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] onboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. After the ''Purge'' broke down, it came across an abandoned [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|Star Destroyer]]. When the crew that went on board the ship got sick and were brought down to the medical bay, they unleashed the sickness which affected everyone on board with the exception of six people. Tugnut caught the virus and died.<ref name="Death" />
